g.text: REV A: separate interruption LEDs removed by user; scene LED turns red on interruption.

g.desc: REV A: separate interruption LEDs removed by user; scene LED turns red on interruption.

g.text: No board modification; no extra GPIO taps.

g.desc: No board modification; no extra GPIO taps.

g.text: Do NOT feed the VOUT pad.

g.desc: Do NOT feed the VOUT pad.

g.text: No battery / second USB power source.

g.text: CPX retained | 2 RGB eyes | 1 RGB scene LED | all 10 onboard NeoPixels | recorded WAV playback

g.desc: CPX retained | 2 RGB eyes | 1 RGB scene LED | all 10 onboard NeoPixels | recorded WAV playback

g.text: Two separate resistor + LED branches per eye-color GPIO.

g.text: Eye red/blue brightness independent; both eyes share each color.

g.desc: Eye red/blue brightness independent; both eyes share each color.

g.text: BOM: 4 x 2.2k + 3 x 1k resistors, >=1/8W. LED physical lead order must be identified before wiring.

g.desc: BOM: 4 x 2.2k + 3 x 1k resistors, >=1/8W. LED physical lead order must be identified before wiring.
